commit.message:
avformat/matroskaenc: reserve space for BlockAdditionMapping even if Matroska muxer isn't enabled

An attempt to use the space will be done even if the Matroska muxer is
disabled, which will mean data will be written where no space was reserved
for it, (track->blockadditionmapping_offset will be 0, on top of it).

Signed-off-by: James Almer <jamrial@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit 5cb31ca5b28a13057070769daa73bb1486e6b542)
